OwnTV Fanart is a modified, unofficial version of OwnTV, the app created by ahXN00. It adds the picture-led design, the guide\'s fanart and other changes, maintained by Carlos (carlosglcn) since October 2026. Report problems with this version on its own GitHub, not to the original author.
What shows next to the channel list over the player: the programme\'s picture, or the channel\'s coming schedule
The same rows, four ways to show them. You can change it later in Settings › Fanart

The title large over its picture, and a dock that rises from the bottom with one wide card and narrow ones, a tab for each row
The rows on the left and a fixed panel on the right with what you point at
Colours, page and accent chosen to match. ✦ Glass styles look their best on a stronger device; elsewhere they show without blur
